id.description: Integration id, unique across integrations; also the provider id.

deepLink.description: Optional link to the API's own UI, shown on the integration's tile.

url.description: The http(s) URL polled; it may not carry user:password@, and a query parameter whose name suggests a credential is refused (use auth.scheme query).

headers.description: Literal, non-secret request headers. A name that names a credential (Authorization, Cookie, X-Api-Key, X-Auth-Token, …) is refused by validation: credentials come from credentialEnv.

body.description: A JSON request body, sent with POST only. A key whose name suggests a credential is refused.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding a credential, never its value.

auth.description: How the credentialEnv value is sent; without it the value is the raw Authorization header.

scheme.description: bearer: Authorization: Bearer <value>; basic: the value is user:password, sent base64-encoded; header: the value in the named header; query: the value in the named URL query parameter.

header.description: The header carrying the credential, for scheme header.

param.description: The query parameter carrying the credential, for scheme query.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds a poll may take, redirects and body included; default 5000.

ttlMs.description: Milliseconds the data stays fresh; default the poll interval.

maxBytes.description: The largest response body accepted, in bytes; default 1048576 (1 MiB).

followCrossOriginRedirects.description: Follow a redirect to another origin (scheme, host or port); default false, so only redirects within the url's origin are followed. Ignored with credentialEnv: an authenticated poll never leaves the url's origin.
